gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-georgian: Dark and spiky, Eater sprawls its letters apart with thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems. Noto Serif Georgian then tightens things up with a text serif that feels literary, and a headline around twice the body size lets the two breathe.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-gujarati: Wide gaps between letters give Eater its menacing, scattered look, all thin strokes and short ascenders. Noto Serif Gujarati settles underneath with oversized e and a counters, so the aggressive top line hands off to something bookish and authoritative.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-gurmukhi: Eater is all menace, with thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems and gaps stretched between its letters. Noto Serif Gurmukhi sits below with a generous x-height and a gradual weight change, so the shift feels like a growl giving way to a literary murmur.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-hebrew: Eater looks dark and aggressive, its thin strokes and short ascenders spread out across wide letter gaps like something prowling the page. Noto Serif Hebrew keeps long reading sturdy and authoritative.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-kannada: Short ascenders and wide letter gaps make Eater feel aggressive from the first word. Yet Noto Serif Kannada brings big counters in a tall lowercase, a traditional classic serif that gives the dark heading something literary to lean against.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-khmer: Noto Serif Khmer reads as classic and authoritative, its tall lowercase sitting very close to the capitals. Over many paragraphs it stays dignified, with only modest thinning at the curves, while Eater supplies the dark, aggressive opening.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-khojki: Noto Serif Khojki reads refined and literary, with short ascenders above big bowls and only low-key thick-thin variation. Eater is the sharp one here.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-lao: Authoritative and bookish, Noto Serif Lao has a big lowercase height next to its capitals and bowls with gentle weight shifts. Eater does dark, aggressive display best, while the text serif handles everything meant to be read.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-makasar: Noto Serif Makasar has a soft step from heavy to light strokes and an x-height as stubby and tall as a carpenter's pencil. Eater then adds the dark, widely spaced menace above it.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-malayalam: Dark, jagged, and widely spaced: that is Eater. Noto Serif Malayalam answers with big open counters in every small letter and bowls that thin gracefully, so a long stretch of this bookish serif reads smoothly after the heading's snarl.
